license: Metadata CC BY 4.0. Each record retains the license of its source.
note: An evidence map, not a contact scrape or a leaderboard. Every record names what it can support, what it cannot, and how it was graded. A graded record is not an endorsement.

evidenceGrades.A: Raw data, code, held-out units or sessions, and independent replication.
evidenceGrades.B: Raw data and code, with held-out sessions or units from one lab.
evidenceGrades.C: Processed data or no code, from one lab.
evidenceGrades.D: Paper, demo, or press release; not independently reproducible from the record.

coverage.scope: High-value records for e-nose builders, datasets, papers, hardware, and claims. Deliberately not a bulk scrape.
knownGaps: Few records expose per-unit and per-session splits together.
Most papers report closed-set accuracy without a fixed false-alarm rate.
Long-term drift, mixtures, and open-set rejection remain under-covered.
Public contact routes are included only when the source publishes them.

records.title: SmellNet
records.summary: 300 recordings of 50 kitchen substances on a six-channel MOX + MEMS array, collected over 50 hours.
claims: Closed-set substance classification on the recorded array.
Time-series feature extraction and cross-substance comparison.
limits: Single array and single campaign; not a cross-rig calibration.
Substance labels are closed-set and do not imply open-set rejection.
Absolute concentration is not available from the raw response.

records.title: Food Freshness E-Nose
records.summary: 59 recordings of produce left to spoil across several days on an eight-channel MQ array.
claims: Slow spoilage trends across days on one array.
limits: Sampled across days, not seconds; not suitable for fast kinetics.
No per-unit or per-session held-out design in the deposit.
Some recordings mix two or three produce types.

records.title: TADI Methane Controlled Releases
records.summary: Six low-cost MOX logger recordings of controlled outdoor methane releases, plus wind and reference methane.
claims: Change detection and release-event analysis on outdoor plumes.
limits: Controlled release, not a leak detector or safety device.
Held-out board detection at a zero-false-alarm point is low and variable.
Weather and plume geometry dominate the raw response.

records.title: UCI Gas Sensor Array Drift
records.summary: 13,910 measurements from 16 Figaro MOX sensors across 36 months and ten gases.
records.license: CC BY 4.0 on the UCI page; donor text has also been read as research-only
claims: Long-term drift benchmarking and session-aware evaluation.
limits: The license wording is contradictory; check before redistribution.
Baseline/offset alone carries a strong gas-class signal.
Batch design is not a cross-unit transfer experiment.

records.title: UCI Twin Gas Sensor Arrays
records.summary: Five physical copies of the same eight-sensor MOX array, measured on the same analytes.
limits: Five units from one lab and one protocol.
Not a field or long-term drift dataset.
Closed-set classes only.

records.title: Two-board BME688 Spice Recordings
records.summary: Raw and pre-processed recordings from two eight-sensor BME688 boards exposed to seven spices, a salt control, and ambient air.
claims: Board-to-board comparison on the same spice protocol.
limits: Two boards from one lab; not an independent replication.
Spice headspace is a mixture, not a pure compound.
The salt control is not a universal clean-air reference.

records.title: Session-level Standardisation Materials
records.summary: Analysis code and retained results for a session-level evaluation of metal-oxide e-nose standardisation.
claims: Where standardisation statistics come from and how session choice changes them.
limits: Research materials, not a drop-in calibration library.
Results depend on the retained splits and source datasets.
Not a validation of Osmograph's detector.

records.title: Gold4 Long-term Conducting Polymer Stability
records.summary: Long-term repeatability and stability measurements from an Aromascan A32S conducting-polymer array, acquired in 1999.
claims: Sensor-array stability over long time spans.
limits: A single historical instrument.
Conducting-polymer behaviour is not a MOX calibration.
The age of the data limits protocol reconstruction.

records.title: Eight-channel Ordered Mixture Screening
records.summary: Raw e-nose measurements, normalised responses, duplicate groups, and grouped classification code for Danggui-Duhuo mixtures.
claims: Ordered mixture screening with duplicate-aware grouped splits.
limits: Single instrument and a narrow mixture family.
Composition labels are not concentration measurements in air.
Duplicate groups matter; random splits inflate the result.

records.title: H2 / NH3 / NO2 Exposures
records.summary: Raw gas-sensor exposures to hydrogen, ammonia, and nitrogen dioxide, published through Mendeley Data.
limits: Three target gases, not a broad odour space.
Check the license and sensor metadata before reuse.
Single-gas exposures do not establish mixture performance.

records.title: Plastic Combustion Emissions
records.summary: 1,200 raw CSV records from six polymer classes, with temperature and humidity compensation work.
claims: Closed-set polymer classification from combustion emissions.
limits: Combustion is a hazardous, mixture-heavy context.
Closed-set polymer classes are not fire-safety advice.
Temperature and humidity compensation are part of the claim.

records.title: MOOSY-32 Prostate Cancer Assessment
records.summary: Processed urine-headspace measurements from a 32-sensor e-nose for a 40-patient prostate-cancer assessment cohort.
claims: Research association between urine headspace and prostate-cancer status.
limits: Processed data, not raw time series.
Clinical research context; not a diagnostic device.
Requires independent clinical validation before any health claim.

records.title: Micro-Olfaction / SOLAR+
records.summary: Research materials for few-shot streaming drift compensation on microcontroller-class gas-sensor arrays.
claims: Resource-aware online drift compensation at the edge.
limits: Method and research materials, not a validated product calibration.
Edge memory claims need independent reproduction.
Not a substitute for per-unit baseline verification.

records.title: Scentronic: an AI-assisted olfactory interface for remote odor sharing
records.summary: A 2026 Science Advances system that couples an AI-assisted odor-sensing platform to a wearable piezoelectric olfactory actuator for remote odor sharing.
claims: A five-scent remote-sharing demonstration with a wearable olfactory actuator.
limits: A demo is not universal smell identification.
The scent set is closed and small.
No open raw time series in the record.

records.title: 16-element CNT-FET food spoilage chip
records.summary: A 2026 Science Advances chip paper reporting 92.6% across 16 objects, with a 99.0% spoilage-only sub-task.
claims: 92.6% closed-set classification across 16 objects; 99.0% on the spoilage-only sub-task.
limits: The 99.0% figure is a sub-task, not the headline result.
Closed-set lab objects, not open-set field identification.
Do not present the sub-task as universal food-safety performance.

records.title: A principal odor map of human olfaction
records.summary: A 2023 Science paper mapping molecular structure to perceptual odor qualities across a large odorant set.
claims: A learned map of odorant structure and perceived quality.
limits: Human perception, not an e-nose measurement.
A perceptual map is not a sensor calibration.
Does not establish universal smell identification.

records.title: Bosch BME688
records.summary: A low-power environmental sensor with a gas-sensitive MOX layer, temperature, pressure, and humidity.
claims: A compact gas-sensitive element with environmental context on the same package.
limits: One gas-sensitive layer is not a selective array.
Vendor gas-index outputs are not a concentration measurement.
Heater profile and calibration strongly affect results.
